notes: Entry routes: U = D1 & (D2 | D3); 'D1&D2' = D2 true (UniProt score <= 2), with or without D3; 'D3 only' = D3 true and D2 false. Definition-artefact flag = UniProt score 5 OR Complex Portal subunit OR >= 1 experimental GO CC term (current GAF, D1 evidence codes). CORUM is not in data/raw and was not used.
N1 classes: random-50 = audit agent (results/audit/curation_lag_audit.tsv); candidate sets = agent L (results/m7/L/index_batch_*.tsv). Fisher p-values in the TSVs are exploratory and unadjusted.
